protocol: train_cached.py --dataset CUB --epochs 50 --batch_size 64 --class_avg_concept --CBM_type clip_cbm --concept_file <bank>, alpha in {0, 1}, identical to Plan 08's protocol
metric: best-epoch source (CUB in-domain) / target (CUB-Painting, shift) accuracy
caveat: gemini_grounded and dino_clip_grounded both have far more concepts (1842, 1328) than every other bank (263-312). Their downstream-accuracy lead is confounded with bank size the same way raw (non-size-normalized) CLIP-similarity coverage was in vlm_concepts_eval_quality.py -- more concept-activation dimensions feeding the classifier could itself explain the gain, independent of per-concept quality. RESOLVED below: the confound is real and accounts for most, but not all, of the full-size advantage.

size_controlled_followup.protocol: vlm_concepts_subsample_bank.py subsamples each bank down to 263 concepts (Qwen2-VL's actual size, same anchor used for the CLIP-similarity size-normalization), 3 independent random seeds, same train_cached.py protocol as above.
size_controlled_followup.interpretation: At matched size (alpha=1, target/shift accuracy): qwen2vl 57.63%, human 57.04%, gemini_sub263 58.65% (down from 63.44% at full size -- ~83% of its full-size edge over qwen2vl was pure bank-size effect), llm_draw1 59.07%, dino_clip_sub263 60.16% (down from 63.93% -- ~55% of its full-size edge was bank size, but a real, low-variance edge over qwen2vl and llm_draw1 survives), llm_draw2 61.40% (still the single best bank at any size tested). Bottom line: the 'image-grounded/retrieval VLM banks beat everything' full-size finding was mostly a bank-size artifact for Gemini, and partly (not entirely) one for DINO+CLIP -- neither image-grounded VLM leg (Gemini, Qwen2-VL) beats the best text-only LLM draw once size is controlled; DINO+CLIP's non-generative retrieval mechanism is the one new pipeline that holds a genuine, small, low-variance edge over the weaker baselines at matched size.
